method: Read-only post-run SSH hash collection, local exact Git blob/source/log/XML/scalar review. No GPU, test or simulation rerun.

source_binding.scope: All frozen physmorph files plus selected fixture/probe/launcher dependencies; post-run stat stability, not attested loaded binaries.

logged_selection.units: Mean squared speeds wu^2/s^2; descriptive synthetic-fixture result, not production repair.

capability_assertions_in_bound_test: Exactly three baseline and three confirming gate passes.
Resolved positions/full F trajectory and terminal F/v/C match the saved last confirmed forward exactly.
No extra registration forward: selection context model.adjoint remains None.
One newly pinned ID has nonzero head terminal velocity but zero coast V/C, and is excluded from primary surviving-free objective.
Selected end does not prematurely carry Fp or pin; donor history stays unchanged.
CuPy asnumpy, Warp array.numpy and Torch CUDA-to-CPU array copies blocked during search/selection; scalar host control remains allowed.

sampled_memory.scope: Sampled device/process memory, including non-Torch ownership; sequential queries, not an exact high-water mark

limitations: Data/volume/render/silhouette/full-merit constraints are constant synthetic expressions and the raw-shape callback is a pass stub. This is not native quality feasibility.
The test assembles and resolves selected whole-window state; it does not run an actual production outer commit or controlled successor solve.
Only confirmation scalar reports are printed. Baseline triplet arrays, candidate traces, complete gates and resolved arrays are test assertions, not independently replayable archived witnesses.
Seven of 24 surviving-free IDs have increased geometric and stored energy; aggregate decrease is not per-particle rest.
No N300k memory/quality conclusion, full-morph rest, hole removal, native derivative finite difference, candidate policy adoption or 4K rendering claim.
No external-library binary hashes or independent GPU rerun; exact source bindings are post-run evidence. Memory is sampled, not an exact allocator high-water mark.
